race.comment: Tough race with plenty of chances. MISS TRENTINO (9) won three-in-a-row last prep and had mixed fortunes in her two runs back. Struck plenty of trouble at the start and never got into the contest when seventh over 1100m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Key jockey change from the right gate and set to bounce back. GENEROUS HARRY (1) dug deep to score first up, then knocked up late after working hard early with the 59kg when seventh over 1000m at Warwick Farm. Kept fresh and has a good record here. Top three player. SPARTUS (2) comes here deep into the campaign and racing in career-best form. Massive win from the outside gate when saluting at Warwick Farm over 1000m in this company. Expect Lloyd to get the best out of him again. NOT WRITTEN OFF (6) sharp Scone-trained mare resuming. Has the ability to test this field from the good draw and was a recent 800m trial winner. Value contender.
